agent_notes: Pages mostly state intervals only; no per-job minutes found for any chore. Fetch quotes come from WebFetch summarizer output, re-check if script mismatches. No source found for artificial plant cleaning or floater skim interval beyond 'during water changes'.

sources.quote: As a rule of thumb, it’s wise to clean and sponge filters every two weeks.
rinse in old tank water taken from the water change bucket

sponge_interval_weeks.note: Interval only. Sponge every 2 weeks (PFK) vs monthly (FishyHub; the quote does not itself contain 'monthly', it is the sponge item under its monthly list - weak). Our 0.5 min/week average vs ~1 min per job every 2 weeks is untestable.

sponge_job_min.note: No page opened states minutes for a sponge rinse.

internal_job.note: PFK page explicitly gives no guidance for internal filters; no other opened page does.

hob_job.note: PFK page gives nothing for HOB. Search snippets (not opened) said every 2-4 weeks; not citable. Charterhouse says filter monthly generically but no HOB-specific quote.

sources.states: every four weeks (half of biological media)
sources.quote: Aim to clean around half of your biological media in aquarium water every four weeks.

canister_job.note: Interval only: every 4 weeks, half the media, alternating chambers. Minutes not stated. Ours 1.5 min/week = ~6 min per 4-week job, untestable.

sources.quote: Use an algae scraper or magnetic cleaner to remove algae from the glass.

glass_wipe_interval.note: Interval: weekly (Charterhouse, listed in its weekly checklist) vs every 2 weeks (FishyHub, under Biweekly). Quotes are weak: neither contains the interval word beside the task. Agrees with weekly or biweekly practice.

sources.quote: Most of the work concentrates in a 15–30 minute weekly session.

glass_wipe_min.note: Per-task minutes not stated; only whole weekly session 15-30 min (includes water change).

sources.quote: Stem plants (Rotala, Hygrophila, Ludwigia) need weekly trimming in high-tech tanks.

stem_trim_interval.note: Weekly interval matches our per-week assumption; minutes per trim not stated.

sources.quote: Carpet plants (HC Cuba, Monte Carlo, dwarf hairgrass) need horizontal trimming every 2–3 weeks.
Remove excess by hand during water changes

floater_skim_interval.note: Page gives no fixed schedule; thin at each water change.

sources.quote: If algae becomes excessive, gently clean decorations using aquarium-safe methods.

artificial_plant_clean_interval.note: Decorations generally, listed monthly; artificial plants not named.

established_tank_test_interval.suggest: every 1-4 weeks; weekly if cautious, 2-4 weeks typical once established (3+ months)

sources.states: every 2-4 weeks for established tank (3+ months)
sources.quote: For an established tank (3+ months), testing every 2–4 weeks is sufficient unless problems are suspected.
Regular testing helps identify issues before they affect fish.

established_tank_test_interval.note: Sources disagree: Charterhouse lists testing in its weekly checklist (quote itself has no interval word), FishyHub says 2-4 weeks. Weekly is the conservative end.

test_kit_min.note: No opened page states how long a liquid test kit run takes.
